statements.impact_statement: PROVEN false-positive: the fix is in the pinned commit. Alloy 1.20.0 pins Loki by commit 5cf8c23a258d (2026-09-15, from Loki main), which Go renders as the pseudo-version v3.0.0-20260915071729-5cf8c23a258d; Trivy compares its v3.0.0 base against the advisory's '< 3.6.4' and flags it. The fix (GHSA-497x-rrr9-68jp, double-encoded path traversal in the Ruler API namespace) is grafana/loki PR #20437, merged to main on 2026-01-15 as 9f5d215c07344d1ff93821b1bfd4c37b23e885c1 and backported to release-3.6.x as #20463 for the 3.6.4 tag. Verified with the GitHub compare API rather than by date: 9f5d215c...5cf8c23a258d is status=ahead, ahead_by=2097, behind_by=0, so the pinned commit contains the fix. v3.6.4 itself shows as diverged only because it lives on the release branch. Scoped to this exact pseudo-version: a different Loki commit must be re-checked.
